#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Небольшая программа для скачивания видео с YouTube (через yt-dlp)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import queue
import shutil
import subprocess
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

DOWNLOADS = Path.home() / "Downloads"
YT_DLP = shutil.which("yt-dlp") or "/opt/homebrew/bin/yt-dlp"
FFMPEG = shutil.which("ffmpeg") or "/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg"

QUALITIES = {
    "Лучшее качество": "bv*+ba/b",
    "1080p": "bv*[height<=1080]+ba/b[height<=1080]/b",
    "720p": "bv*[height<=720]+ba/b[height<=720]/b",
    "480p": "bv*[height<=480]+ba/b[height<=480]/b",
    "Только аудио (MP3)": None,
}

BROWSERS = ("safari", "chrome", "firefox", "brave", "edge", "chromium")


class YouTubeDownloader(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.title("YouTube Downloader")
        self.geometry("720x560")
        self.minsize(640, 480)

        self.url = tk.StringVar()
        self.folder = tk.StringVar(value=str(DOWNLOADS))
        self.quality = tk.StringVar(value="1080p")
        self.browser = tk.StringVar(value="safari")
        self.use_cookies = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.whole_playlist = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)

        self._proc: subprocess.Popen[str] | None = None
        self._log_queue: queue.Queue[str] = queue.Queue()
        self._busy = False

        self._build()
        self.after(80, self._drain_log)
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._on_close)

    def _build(self) -> None:
        pad = {"padx": 14, "pady": 6}
        root = ttk.Frame(self, padding=16)
        root.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        ttk.Label(root, text="Скачать видео с YouTube", font=("Helvetica", 16, "bold")).pack(
            anchor=tk.W, pady=(0, 10)
        )

        ttk.Label(root, text="Ссылка на видео или плейлист").pack(anchor=tk.W)
        url_row = ttk.Frame(root)
        url_row.pack(fill=tk.X, **pad)
        url_entry = ttk.Entry(url_row, textvariable=self.url)
        url_entry.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True)
        url_entry.focus_set()
        ttk.Button(url_row, text="Вставить", command=self._paste).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))

        ttk.Label(root, text="Папка сохранения").pack(anchor=tk.W)
        folder_row = ttk.Frame(root)
        folder_row.pack(fill=tk.X, **pad)
        ttk.Entry(folder_row, textvariable=self.folder).pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True)
        ttk.Button(folder_row, text="Выбрать…", command=self._pick_folder).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))

        opts = ttk.Frame(root)
        opts.pack(fill=tk.X, **pad)

        ttk.Label(opts, text="Качество").pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        ttk.Combobox(
            opts,
            textvariable=self.quality,
            values=list(QUALITIES),
            state="readonly",
            width=22,
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 18))

        ttk.Checkbutton(
            opts,
            text="Весь плейлист",
            variable=self.whole_playlist,
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        cookies = ttk.Frame(root)
        cookies.pack(fill=tk.X, **pad)
        ttk.Checkbutton(
            cookies,
            text="Cookies браузера (если YouTube просит войти)",
            variable=self.use_cookies,
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        ttk.Combobox(
            cookies,
            textvariable=self.browser,
            values=BROWSERS,
            state="readonly",
            width=10,
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))

        btns = ttk.Frame(root)
        btns.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(8, 8))
        self.download_btn = ttk.Button(btns, text="Скачать", command=self._start)
        self.download_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        self.cancel_btn = ttk.Button(btns, text="Стоп", command=self._cancel, state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.cancel_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))
        ttk.Button(btns, text="Открыть папку", command=self._open_folder).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))

        self.status = ttk.Label(root, text="Готово. Вставь ссылку и нажми «Скачать».")
        self.status.pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(0, 6))

        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(root, mode="determinate", maximum=100)
        self.progress.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 8))

        log_frame = ttk.Frame(root)
        log_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.log = tk.Text(log_frame, height=14, wrap=tk.WORD, font=("Menlo", 11))
        scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(log_frame, command=self.log.yview)
        self.log.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set, state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.log.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        scroll.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        ttk.Label(
            root,
            text="Нужны yt-dlp и ffmpeg. Скачивай только то, на что есть право.",
            foreground="#666",
        ).pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(8, 0))

    def _paste(self) -> None:
        try:
            text = self.clipboard_get().strip()
        except tk.TclError:
            return
        if text:
            self.url.set(text)

    def _pick_folder(self) -> None:
        chosen = filedialog.askdirectory(initialdir=self.folder.get() or str(DOWNLOADS))
        if chosen:
            self.folder.set(chosen)

    def _open_folder(self) -> None:
        folder = Path(self.folder.get()).expanduser()
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        subprocess.Popen(["open", str(folder)])

    def _append(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.log.insert(tk.END, text)
        if not text.endswith("\n"):
            self.log.insert(tk.END, "\n")
        self.log.see(tk.END)
        self.log.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)

    def _drain_log(self) -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                line = self._log_queue.get_nowait()
                self._append(line)
                self._maybe_progress(line)
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.after(80, self._drain_log)

    def _maybe_progress(self, line: str) -> None:
        if "%" not in line:
            return
        for part in line.replace("%", "% ").split():
            if part.endswith("%"):
                try:
                    value = float(part[:-1])
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if 0 <= value <= 100:
                    self.progress["value"] = value
                    return

    def _start(self) -> None:
        url = self.url.get().strip()
        if not url:
            messagebox.showinfo("Нет ссылки", "Вставь ссылку на видео YouTube.")
            return
        if not Path(YT_DLP).exists():
            messagebox.showerror(
                "Нет yt-dlp",
                "Не найден yt-dlp. Установи: brew install yt-dlp",
            )
            return
        if not Path(FFMPEG).exists():
            messagebox.showerror(
                "Нет ffmpeg",
                "Не найден ffmpeg. Установи: brew install ffmpeg",
            )
            return

        folder = Path(self.folder.get()).expanduser()
        try:
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            messagebox.showerror("Папка", f"Не удалось создать папку:\n{exc}")
            return

        cmd = self._build_command(url, folder)
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.progress["value"] = 0
        self.status.configure(text="Скачиваю…")
        self._append("$ " + " ".join(cmd))

        thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, args=(cmd,), daemon=True)
        thread.start()

    def _build_command(self, url: str, folder: Path) -> list[str]:
        quality = self.quality.get()
        audio_only = QUALITIES[quality] is None
        output = str(folder / "%(title).200B [%(id)s].%(ext)s")
        if self.whole_playlist.get():
            output = str(folder / "%(playlist_index)03d - %(title).200B [%(id)s].%(ext)s")

        cmd = [
            YT_DLP,
            "--no-color",
            "--newline",
            "--no-mtime",
            "--concurrent-fragments",
            "4",
            "--ffmpeg-location",
            str(Path(FFMPEG).parent),
            "-o",
            output,
            "--embed-metadata",
        ]
        if self.whole_playlist.get():
            cmd.append("--yes-playlist")
        else:
            cmd.append("--no-playlist")

        if audio_only:
            cmd.extend(["-x", "--audio-format", "mp3", "--audio-quality", "0"])
        else:
            cmd.extend(
                [
                    "-f",
                    QUALITIES[quality],
                    "--merge-output-format",
                    "mp4",
                ]
            )

        if self.use_cookies.get():
            cmd.extend(["--cookies-from-browser", self.browser.get()])

        cmd.append(url)
        return cmd

    def _run(self, cmd: list[str]) -> None:
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["PATH"] = "/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:" + env.get("PATH", "")
        try:
            self._proc = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
                env=env,
            )
            assert self._proc.stdout is not None
            for line in self._proc.stdout:
                self._log_queue.put(line.rstrip())
            code = self._proc.wait()
        except OSError as exc:
            self._log_queue.put(f"Ошибка запуска: {exc}")
            self.after(0, lambda: self._finished(False, "Не удалось запустить yt-dlp"))
            return
        finally:
            self._proc = None

        if code == 0:
            self.after(0, lambda: self._finished(True, "Готово. Файл в выбранной папке."))
        elif code < 0:
            self.after(0, lambda: self._finished(False, "Остановлено."))
        else:
            self.after(0, lambda: self._finished(False, f"Ошибка (код {code}). Смотри лог ниже."))

    def _finished(self, ok: bool, text: str) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        self.status.configure(text=text)
        if ok:
            self.progress["value"] = 100
            messagebox.showinfo("Скачано", text)
        elif "Остановлено" not in text:
            messagebox.showerror("Не скачалось", text)

    def _cancel(self) -> None:
        proc = self._proc
        if proc and proc.poll() is None:
            proc.terminate()
            self.status.configure(text="Останавливаю…")

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        self.download_btn.configure(state=tk.DISABLED if busy else tk.NORMAL)
        self.cancel_btn.configure(state=tk.NORMAL if busy else tk.DISABLED)

    def _on_close(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            if not messagebox.askyesno("Скачивание", "Остановить скачивание и выйти?"):
                return
            self._cancel()
        self.destroy()


def main() -> None:
    app = YouTubeDownloader()
    app.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
exec python3 youtube_downloader.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Небольшая программа для скачивания видео с YouTube (через yt-dlp)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import queue
import shutil
import subprocess
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

APP_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LOG_FILE = APP_DIR / "last_run.log"
DOWNLOADS = Path.home() / "Downloads"
YT_DLP = shutil.which("yt-dlp") or "/opt/homebrew/bin/yt-dlp"
FFMPEG = shutil.which("ffmpeg") or "/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg"
DENO = shutil.which("deno") or "/opt/homebrew/bin/deno"

QUALITIES = {
    "Лучшее качество": "bv*+ba/b",
    "1080p": "bv*[height<=1080]+ba/b[height<=1080]/b",
    "720p": "bv*[height<=720]+ba/b[height<=720]/b",
    "480p": "bv*[height<=480]+ba/b[height<=480]/b",
    "Только аудио (MP3)": None,
}

BROWSERS = ("chrome", "vivaldi", "safari", "firefox", "brave", "edge", "chromium")


def explain_error(text: str) -> str:
    low = text.lower()
    if "sign in to confirm you're not a bot" in low or "not a bot" in low:
        return (
            "YouTube решил, что это бот. Включи «Cookies браузера», выбери Chrome "
            "и попробуй снова. Если включён VPN — выключи его."
        )
    if "requested format is not available" in low:
        return "Такого качества нет. Выбери «Лучшее качество» и скачай ещё раз."
    if "private video" in low:
        return "Видео приватное, скачать нельзя."
    if "video unavailable" in low or "this video is unavailable" in low:
        return "Видео недоступно (удалено или заблокировано в регионе)."
    if "http error 403" in low or "403: forbidden" in low:
        return "YouTube отклонил запрос (часто из‑за VPN). Выключи VPN или включи cookies Chrome."
    if "could not copy" in low or "could not find" in low and "cookie" in low:
        return (
            "Не удалось прочитать cookies браузера. Для Chrome нажми Allow в окне связки ключей. "
            "Для Safari дай Терминалу доступ к диску в Настройках → Конфиденциальность."
        )
    if "confirm your age" in low or "age-restricted" in low:
        return "Видео с ограничением по возрасту. Включи cookies браузера, где ты залогинен на YouTube."
    if "ffmpeg" in low and ("not found" in low or "не найден" in low):
        return "Не найден ffmpeg. В терминале: brew install ffmpeg"
    for line in reversed(text.splitlines()):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.lower().startswith("error"):
            return stripped
    return "Не получилось скачать. Текст ошибки — в логе внизу."


class YouTubeDownloader(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.title("YouTube Downloader")
        self.geometry("740x580")
        self.minsize(640, 480)

        self.url = tk.StringVar()
        self.folder = tk.StringVar(value=str(DOWNLOADS))
        self.quality = tk.StringVar(value="1080p")
        self.browser = tk.StringVar(value="chrome")
        self.use_cookies = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.whole_playlist = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)

        self._proc: subprocess.Popen[str] | None = None
        self._log_queue: queue.Queue[str] = queue.Queue()
        self._busy = False
        self._lines: list[str] = []

        self._build()
        self.after(80, self._drain_log)
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._on_close)

    def _build(self) -> None:
        pad = {"padx": 14, "pady": 6}
        root = ttk.Frame(self, padding=16)
        root.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        ttk.Label(root, text="Скачать видео с YouTube", font=("Helvetica", 16, "bold")).pack(
            anchor=tk.W, pady=(0, 10)
        )

        ttk.Label(root, text="Ссылка на видео или плейлист").pack(anchor=tk.W)
        url_row = ttk.Frame(root)
        url_row.pack(fill=tk.X, **pad)
        url_entry = ttk.Entry(url_row, textvariable=self.url)
        url_entry.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True)
        url_entry.focus_set()
        ttk.Button(url_row, text="Вставить", command=self._paste).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))

        ttk.Label(root, text="Папка сохранения").pack(anchor=tk.W)
        folder_row = ttk.Frame(root)
        folder_row.pack(fill=tk.X, **pad)
        ttk.Entry(folder_row, textvariable=self.folder).pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True)
        ttk.Button(folder_row, text="Выбрать…", command=self._pick_folder).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))

        opts = ttk.Frame(root)
        opts.pack(fill=tk.X, **pad)

        ttk.Label(opts, text="Качество").pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        ttk.Combobox(
            opts,
            textvariable=self.quality,
            values=list(QUALITIES),
            state="readonly",
            width=22,
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 18))

        ttk.Checkbutton(opts, text="Весь плейлист", variable=self.whole_playlist).pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        cookies = ttk.Frame(root)
        cookies.pack(fill=tk.X, **pad)
        ttk.Checkbutton(
            cookies,
            text="Cookies браузера (если YouTube просит войти)",
            variable=self.use_cookies,
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        ttk.Combobox(
            cookies,
            textvariable=self.browser,
            values=BROWSERS,
            state="readonly",
            width=10,
        ).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))

        btns = ttk.Frame(root)
        btns.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(8, 8))
        self.download_btn = ttk.Button(btns, text="Скачать", command=self._start)
        self.download_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        self.cancel_btn = ttk.Button(btns, text="Стоп", command=self._cancel, state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.cancel_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))
        ttk.Button(btns, text="Открыть папку", command=self._open_folder).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(8, 0))

        self.status = ttk.Label(root, text="Готово. Вставь ссылку и нажми «Скачать».")
        self.status.pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(0, 6))

        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(root, mode="determinate", maximum=100)
        self.progress.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 8))

        log_frame = ttk.Frame(root)
        log_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.log = tk.Text(log_frame, height=14, wrap=tk.WORD, font=("Menlo", 11))
        scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(log_frame, command=self.log.yview)
        self.log.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set, state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.log.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        scroll.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        ttk.Label(
            root,
            text="Если не качает: выключи VPN и включи cookies Chrome. Скачивай только своё/разрешённое.",
            foreground="#666",
        ).pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(8, 0))

    def _paste(self) -> None:
        try:
            text = self.clipboard_get().strip()
        except tk.TclError:
            return
        if text:
            self.url.set(text)

    def _pick_folder(self) -> None:
        chosen = filedialog.askdirectory(initialdir=self.folder.get() or str(DOWNLOADS))
        if chosen:
            self.folder.set(chosen)

    def _open_folder(self) -> None:
        folder = Path(self.folder.get()).expanduser()
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        subprocess.Popen(["open", str(folder)])

    def _append(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.log.insert(tk.END, text)
        if not text.endswith("\n"):
            self.log.insert(tk.END, "\n")
        self.log.see(tk.END)
        self.log.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)

    def _drain_log(self) -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                line = self._log_queue.get_nowait()
                self._append(line)
                self._maybe_progress(line)
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.after(80, self._drain_log)

    def _maybe_progress(self, line: str) -> None:
        if "[download]" not in line or "%" not in line:
            return
        for part in line.replace("%", "% ").split():
            if part.endswith("%"):
                try:
                    value = float(part[:-1])
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if 0 <= value <= 100:
                    self.progress["value"] = value
                    return

    def _start(self) -> None:
        url = self.url.get().strip()
        if not url:
            messagebox.showinfo("Нет ссылки", "Вставь ссылку на видео YouTube.")
            return
        if not Path(YT_DLP).exists():
            messagebox.showerror("Нет yt-dlp", "Не найден yt-dlp. Установи: brew install yt-dlp")
            return
        if not Path(FFMPEG).exists():
            messagebox.showerror("Нет ffmpeg", "Не найден ffmpeg. Установи: brew install ffmpeg")
            return

        folder = Path(self.folder.get()).expanduser()
        try:
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            messagebox.showerror("Папка", f"Не удалось создать папку:\n{exc}")
            return

        self._set_busy(True)
        self.progress["value"] = 0
        self.status.configure(text="Скачиваю…")
        thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, args=(url, folder), daemon=True)
        thread.start()

    def _build_command(self, url: str, folder: Path | str, *, use_cookies: bool) -> list[str]:
        quality = self.quality.get()
        audio_only = QUALITIES.get(quality) is None
        folder = Path(folder).expanduser()
        output = str(folder / "%(title).200B [%(id)s].%(ext)s")
        if self.whole_playlist.get():
            output = str(folder / "%(playlist_index)03d - %(title).200B [%(id)s].%(ext)s")

        cmd = [
            YT_DLP,
            "--no-color",
            "--newline",
            "--no-mtime",
            "--no-update",
            "--concurrent-fragments",
            "4",
            "--retries",
            "5",
            "--fragment-retries",
            "5",
            "--ffmpeg-location",
            str(Path(FFMPEG).parent),
            "-o",
            output,
        ]
        if Path(DENO).exists():
            cmd.extend(["--js-runtimes", f"deno:{DENO}"])

        if self.whole_playlist.get():
            cmd.append("--yes-playlist")
        else:
            cmd.append("--no-playlist")

        if audio_only:
            cmd.extend(["-x", "--audio-format", "mp3", "--audio-quality", "0"])
        else:
            cmd.extend(["-f", QUALITIES[quality], "--merge-output-format", "mp4"])

        if use_cookies:
            cmd.extend(["--cookies-from-browser", self.browser.get()])

        cmd.append(url)
        return cmd

    def _run_once(self, cmd: list[str]) -> int:
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["PATH"] = "/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:" + env.get("PATH", "")
        self._log("\n$ " + " ".join(cmd))
        self._proc = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            env=env,
        )
        assert self._proc.stdout is not None
        for line in self._proc.stdout:
            self._log(line.rstrip())
        code = self._proc.wait()
        self._proc = None
        return code

    def _log(self, line: str) -> None:
        self._lines.append(line)
        self._log_queue.put(line)

    def _run(self, url: str, folder: Path) -> None:
        self._lines = []
        try:
            cmd = self._build_command(url, folder, use_cookies=self.use_cookies.get())
            code = self._run_once(cmd)
            log_text = "\n".join(self._lines)
            bot_block = "not a bot" in log_text.lower() or "http error 403" in log_text.lower()
            if code != 0 and bot_block and not self.use_cookies.get():
                self._log("\nYouTube не пустил без входа — пробую cookies Chrome…")
                self.after(0, lambda: self.status.configure(text="Повтор с cookies Chrome…"))
                self.after(0, lambda: self.use_cookies.set(True))
                retry = self._build_command(url, folder, use_cookies=True)
                code = self._run_once(retry)
        except OSError as exc:
            self._log(f"Ошибка запуска: {exc}")
            self.after(0, lambda: self._finished(False, "Не удалось запустить yt-dlp"))
            return
        finally:
            self._proc = None
            try:
                LOG_FILE.write_text("\n".join(self._lines), encoding="utf-8")
            except OSError:
                pass

        log_text = "\n".join(self._lines)
        if code == 0:
            self.after(0, lambda: self._finished(True, "Готово. Файл в выбранной папке."))
        elif code < 0:
            self.after(0, lambda: self._finished(False, "Остановлено."))
        else:
            message = explain_error(log_text)
            self.after(0, lambda m=message: self._finished(False, m))

    def _finished(self, ok: bool, text: str) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        self.status.configure(text=text)
        if ok:
            self.progress["value"] = 100
            messagebox.showinfo("Скачано", text)
        elif "Остановлено" not in text:
            messagebox.showerror("Не скачалось", text)

    def _cancel(self) -> None:
        proc = self._proc
        if proc and proc.poll() is None:
            proc.terminate()
            self.status.configure(text="Останавливаю…")

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        self.download_btn.configure(state=tk.DISABLED if busy else tk.NORMAL)
        self.cancel_btn.configure(state=tk.NORMAL if busy else tk.DISABLED)

    def _on_close(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            if not messagebox.askyesno("Скачивание", "Остановить скачивание и выйти?"):
                return
            self._cancel()
        self.destroy()


def main() -> None:
    app = YouTubeDownloader()
    app.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" and pwd)"
cd "$DIR"

echo "========================================"
echo "  Установка Amnezia VPN и Cursor"
echo "  на этот Mac (Air)"
echo "========================================"
echo
echo "Папка: $DIR"
echo "Мак:   $(scutil --get ComputerName 2>/dev/null || echo неизвестно)"
echo "Чип:   $(uname -m)"
echo

if ! osascript -e 'display dialog "Поставить Amnezia VPN и Cursor на этот Mac?" buttons {"Отмена","Поставить"} default button "Поставить"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Отменено."
  exit 0
fi

need_rosetta() {
  [[ "$(uname -m)" == "arm64" ]] && ! /usr/bin/pgrep oahd >/dev/null 2>&1
}

if need_rosetta; then
  echo "Ставлю Rosetta 2 (нужна Amnezia)..."
  softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license || true
fi

AMNEZIA_PKG=""
CURSOR_ZIP=""
CURSOR_APP=""

for f in "$DIR"/AmneziaVPN_*.pkg; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] && AMNEZIA_PKG="$f" && break
done
for f in "$DIR"/Cursor-*.zip "$DIR"/Cursor.zip; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] && CURSOR_ZIP="$f" && break
done
[[ -d "$DIR/Cursor.app" ]] && CURSOR_APP="$DIR/Cursor.app"

if [[ -z "$AMNEZIA_PKG" ]]; then
  echo "Качаю Amnezia VPN 5.0.3.0..."
  curl -L --fail --progress-bar \
    -o "$DIR/AmneziaVPN_5.0.3.0_macos_x64.pkg" \
    "https://github.com/amnezia-vpn/amnezia-client/releases/download/5.0.3.0/AmneziaVPN_5.0.3.0_macos_x64.pkg"
  AMNEZIA_PKG="$DIR/AmneziaVPN_5.0.3.0_macos_x64.pkg"
fi

if [[ -z "$CURSOR_ZIP" && -z "$CURSOR_APP" ]]; then
  echo "Качаю Cursor для Apple Silicon..."
  curl -L --fail --progress-bar \
    -o "$DIR/Cursor-darwin-arm64.zip" \
    "https://downloads.cursor.com/production/5d4df965746c5d09740842fc0f1331ba1c15783d/darwin/arm64/Cursor-darwin-arm64.zip"

osascript -e "do shell script \"installer -pkg '$AMNEZIA_PKG' -target /\" with administrator privileges"

if [[ -n "$CURSOR_ZIP" && -z "$CURSOR_APP" ]]; then
  echo "Распаковываю Cursor..."
  TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
  ditto -xk "$CURSOR_ZIP" "$TMP"
  CURSOR_APP="$(find "$TMP" -name "Cursor.app" -maxdepth 3 -type d | head -1)"
fi

if [[ -n "$CURSOR_APP" ]]; then

  rm -rf "/Applications/Cursor.app"
  ditto "$CURSOR_APP" "/Applications/Cursor.app"
  xattr -cr "/Applications/Cursor.app" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo
echo "Готово."
